# Digital Research LINK 1.3

Unmodified tool selected for the Utilities disk. `provenance.json` records exact
binary identity, upstream revision and redistribution basis. Original ownership
and terms are retained; this is separate from BetterCP/M original code.

`permission.html` retains the archive permission page; `LICENSE` contains
the 2001 grant and July 2022 clarification as text. The HTTP original was used
because the site currently presents a self-signed HTTPS certificate.
